tokens.name: color-ink

tokens.name: color-ink-2

tokens.name: color-ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted ink, and it follows the ground: #7c8294 on the open page (5.3:1), #969080 inside panels and plates (5.2:1 on `color-press`); inside `.field-cream` it is #5c6473 (5.2:1 on cream). The cream hairline is mixed from it.

tokens.name: color-seam

tokens.name: color-seam-deep

tokens.name: color-powder
